description: Manage DNS records in a Memset account.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The address for this record (can be IP or text string depending on record type).

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: The API key obtained from the Memset control panel.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: SRV and TXT record priority, in the range 0 > 999 (inclusive). Default: 0

parameters.name: relative
parameters.description: If set then the current domain is added onto the address field for CNAME, MX, NS and SRVrecord types. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicates desired state of resource. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: The record’s TTL in seconds (will inherit zone’s TTL if not explicitly set). This must be a valid int from https://www.memset.com/apidocs/methods_dns.html#dns.zone_record_create. Choices: 0 ← (default) 300 600 900 1800 3600 7200 10800 21600 43200 86400

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of DNS record to create. Choices: "A" "AAAA" "CNAME" "MX" "NS" "SRV" "TXT"

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: The name of the zone to which to add the record to.

examples:
# Create DNS record for www.domain.com
- name: Create DNS record
  community.general.memset_zone_record:
    api_key: dcf089a2896940da9ffefb307ef49ccd
    state: present
    zone: domain.com
    type: A
    record: www
    address: 1.2.3.4
    ttl: 300
    relative: false
  delegate_to: localhost

# create an SPF record for domain.com
- name: Create SPF record for domain.com
  community.general.memset_zone_record:
    api_key: dcf089a2896940da9ffefb307ef49ccd
    state: present
    zone: domain.com
    type: TXT
    address: "v=spf1 +a +mx +ip4:a1.2.3.4 ?all"
  delegate_to: localhost

# create multiple DNS records
- name: Create multiple DNS records
  community.general.memset_zone_record:
    api_key: dcf089a2896940da9ffefb307ef49ccd
    zone: "{{ item.zone }}"
    type: "{{ item.type }}"
    record: "{{ item.record }}"
    address: "{{ item.address }}"
  delegate_to: localhost
  with_items:
    - {'zone': 'domain1.com', 'type': 'A', 'record': 'www', 'address': '1.2.3.4'}
    - {'zone': 'domain2.com', 'type': 'A', 'record': 'mail', 'address': '4.3.2.1'}

return_values.name: memset_api
return_values.description: Record info from the Memset API. Returned: when state == present

return_values.name: address
return_values.description: Record content (may be an IP, string or blank depending on record type). Returned: always Sample: "1.1.1.1"

return_values.name: priority
return_values.description: Priority for MX and SRV records. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: record
return_values.description: Name of record. Returned: always Sample: "www"

return_values.name: relative
return_values.description: Adds the current domain onto the address field for CNAME, MX, NS and SRV types. Returned: always Sample: false
